Title: Establishes the build more, get more incentive fund
Summary: Establishes the build more, get more incentive fund to provide incentive payments to municipalities based on the number of eligible new housing units produced within such municipality.
LawCode: Add Art 28 §§1240 - 1247, Priv Hous Fin L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the private housing finance law, in relation to establishing the build more, get more incentive fund
